channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'Insult to Mahatma Gandhi': Oppn protests outside Parliament against move to replace MGNREGA
item.description: Raising slogans such as "Gandhiji ka ye apman, nahi sahega Hindustan" and "Mahatma Gandhi Amar Rahe", Opposition parliamentarians accused the BJP-led Centre of removing the name of the Father of the Nation, Mahatma Gandhi, from the rural employment scheme.

item.title: Border 2 teaser launch: Sunny Deol cries during his first public appearance since Dharmendra's death, trolled
item.description: Bollywood actor Sunny Deol made his first public appearance at the teaser launch of Border 2, days after the death of his father, veteran actor Dharmendra, who passed away on November 24 in Mumbai. Sunny was seen with his co-stars Varun Dhawan and Ahan Shetty at the event, while Diljit Dosanjh skipped the launch.

item.title: SOG Jawan killed in action amid encounter in J&K's Majalta; massive search op underway
item.description: A Special Operations Group (SOG) jawan of the J&K Police was killed in action during an encounter with terrorists in Majalta tehsil of Udhampur district on Monday evening. Following the incident, security forces launched an extensive search and cordon operation, sealing all escape routes and deploying additional troops, drones, and helicopters.

item.title: J&K's pacer Auqib Nabi Dar creates IPL history with Rs 8.40 crore Delhi Capitals deal
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir cricket reached a historic milestone as Baramulla-born fast bowler Auqib Nabi Dar was snapped up by Delhi Capitals for a staggering Rs 8.40 crore at the IPL Season 19 mini auction.

item.title: Silver hits record high on MCX, jumps over 4 pc as rate-cut hopes fuel rally
item.description: On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), silver prices surged more than 4 per cent in early trade, extending their recent breakout rally. During early trade, MCX silver was trading 3.38 per cent higher at Rs 2,04,445 per kg after touching a lifetime high level.

item.title: Delhi's air quality shows marginal improvement with strong winds; AQI 'very poor'
item.description: Shallow fog was also observed across several parts of the city during the morning hours. According to official data, the national capital's average Air Quality Index (AQI) stood at 328 at 8 a.m., an improvement from 354 recorded at 4 p.m. on Tuesday.

item.title: US federal court upholds removal order against Indian national
item.description: In a nonprecedential order issued on December 15, a three-judge panel of the US Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit said petitioner Karanpreet Singh "has not demonstrated any prejudice arising from the alleged errors," and therefore denied his request to vacate the removal order.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty trade flat in early deals amid weak global cues
item.description: The Sensex opened 176 points higher at 84,856 but soon gave up its early gains and slipped into the red, touching a low of 84,649. At around 9:25 AM, the index was trading 134 points higher, or 0.2 per cent up, at 84,820. The Nifty was also marginally higher, trading at 25,913, up 53 points or 0.2 per cent.

item.title: Anant Ambani gives Messi a million-dollar gift — literally
item.description: Lionel Messi visited Anant Ambani's Vantara, where he took part in Hindu rituals, experienced wildlife up close, and interacted with caregivers and conservation teams. The team exuded elegance in traditional attire, with a tilak applied on their foreheads while performing the rituals. Take a look at the photos.

item.title: PM Modi invites Ethiopian counterpart Abiy Ahmed Ali to AI Impact Summit, BRICS meet in India
item.description: Briefing the media on the Prime Minister's visit to Ethiopia, MEA Secretary (Economic Relations) Sudhakar Dalela said that India will assume the chairship of the BRICS grouping for a period of one year beginning January 1, 2026.
